name: Radiant Blast (3/day)
description: The creature unleashes a burst of radiant energy in a 120-foot radius. Creatures within the radius must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw, taking 38 (7d8) radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
